subject: gk
question: To assist businesses in complying with legal requirements, governments are;

options.text: Developing rules that are unique compared to other countries.
Harmonizing their laws with international standards.
Disregarding the implementation of legal rules.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmonizing their laws with international standards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Harmonizing laws with international standards** is a widely adopted approach by governments to facilitate seamless business operations across borders, ensuring compliance with global norms.
 
• It involves aligning national legal frameworks with international agreements, treaties, and conventions. For example, trade agreements like **WTO standards** or environmental protocols such as the **Paris Agreement** influence national laws.
 
• This approach helps businesses avoid legal conflicts when operating in multiple countries, fostering **global trade and investment opportunities.**
 
• Harmonization reduces administrative burdens for businesses, as they do not need to adapt to vastly differing legal frameworks in each country.
 
• Adopting international standards ensures uniformity in areas such as **labor laws, tax regulations, environmental compliance, and intellectual property rights.**</li
